news.title: Here are the big stories from Karnataka today
news.summary: Welcome to the Karnataka Today newsletter, your guide from The Hindu on the major news stories to follow today. Curated and written by Nalme Nachiyar.

news.title: How can ECI render case against byelections to five Tamil Nadu constituencies infructuous, wonders CM Vijay’s counsel
news.summary: Appearing before Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan, senior counsel G.

news.title: Patna High Court goes hard on Bihar government over upkeep of Barabar Caves
news.summary: ​Hearing a petition, a single bench of Justice Rajiv Roy questioned the continuous negligence of the ancient site, drawing sharp comparisons to how other states preserve their cultural heritage

news.title: HT Evening Brief Sept 28: ‘No PUC, no fuel’ rule in Delhi to curb winter pollution; PV Sindhu flags Asian Games schedule
news.summary: Here's your 5-minute wrap of the top headlines of the day.

news.title: D.K. Shivakumar petitions defence minister for permission and land
news.summary: The Karnataka Chief Minister proposed development of a permanent public park and lung space on around 730 acres of defence land near the Iblur Firing Range.

news.title: Exclusive: "So L&T Doesn't Lose Heart" - Defence Secretary On Fast-Tracking Zorawar Light Tank
news.summary: The Zorawar light tank was jointly developed by DRDO's Combat Vehicles Research and Development Establishment (CVRDE) and Larsen & Toubro, with L&T handling system integration and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) supplying…

news.title: Exclusive: Defence Secretary Defends $34 Billion 114-Rafale Deal, Says Tejas On Track
news.summary: The IAF's focus on the Rafale comes at a time of depleting squadron strength, with a host of legacy jets such as the MiG-21 being retired.

news.title: ‘Gem Granites’ Veeramani booked in second POCSO Act case
news.summary: The second case was registered based on a complaint lodged by a woman alleging that her daughter, a minor, was sexually abused by the businessman

news.title: Are Gujarat unrecognised political parties a front for tax-evasion?
news.summary: What does the Income Tax Department allege? How much money is involved? How was the money allegedly routed? When did the investigation begin?

news.title: TN central crime branch registers another Pocso case against R Veeramani
news.summary: Veeramani was already booked in a Pocso case, along with his accomplice: Ganeshan, Shanthi and Mahandra Simhan

news.title: ESA row heats up in Keralam; Kerala Congress (M) demands village-wise data, White Paper
news.summary: Party chairman Jose K. Mani, MP, says the inclusion of agricultural land in 25 villages across nine districts on the latest ESA list was a matter of serious concern

news.title: JNPA gets $70 million IFC blue financing for cleaner ship operations
news.summary: JNPA has put the financial implication of the shore-power project at ₹650 crore. The project is expected to cut carbon emissions by 63%

news.title: Supreme Court cancels Shiv Sena corporator Ramesh Mhatre’s bail in Thane doctors’ assault case
news.summary: “The message should go out loud and clear that the medical fraternity cannot be touched. They serve people and cannot be attacked in this manner,” the Supreme Court said

news.title: Coimbatore policeman clings onto SUV roof rails for over 40 km to nab gutkha smugglers
Ashamed of being part of government, says Chirag Paswan over rising molestation cases in Bihar
news.summary: Daring the Central and State leaderships, Mr. Paswan said, “You can send me a notice, you can remove me from the government; it makes no difference to me but I will raise this question.”

news.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay launches Thaimaman Thanga Mothiram Thittam at Madurai
news.summary: The scheme, one of the poll promises of the ruling TVK, envisages gifting a one-gram gold ring to all newborn babies delivered in Tamil Nadu’s government hospitals on or after June 22, (Mr. Vijay’s birthday).

news.title: Three FIRs registered in Kolkata film institute violence
news.summary: Students of the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute clash with members of a right-wing consumer group holding an event inside the campus; police claim students wrongfully restrained on-duty personnel

news.title: TMC symbol row: Supreme Court gives rival factions four weeks to file pleadings, ECI three months to decide dispute
news.summary: The court refuses requests made by the ECI’s side to at least give five or six months instead of the three-month window

news.title: ‘Will we need a special court to consider petitions from AMMA?’ asks Kerala HC
news.summary: High Court criticises the actors’ association over the high number of petitions arising from disputes between its members; observations made while considering a petition to quash an FIR lodged against actor Lakshmipriya

news.title: Exclusive: No Su-57 Decision Yet, Says Defence Secretary. India Leans On AI Networks To Bridge Stealth Gaps

news.summary: He challenges UDF government and the Dairy Development department to supply evidence of corruption; says that people cannot be blamed for suspecting that the dissolution was part of a clandestine move to destroy Milma

news.title: Canara Bank Recruitment 2026: 3,500 Apprentice Posts, Apply From October 1
news.summary: Canara Bank invites online applications from graduates for 3500 Graduate Apprentice posts for 2026-27, with a monthly stipend of Rs 16650.

news.title: Pinarayi Vijayan urges Union, Keralam govts to ensure safe return of Keralite students from unrest-hit Lovely Professional University
news.summary: Kerala Opposition leader Pinarayi Vijayan urged the Union and State governments to secure the safe return of more than 1,500 Malayali students from Lovely Professional University in Jalandhar back to Delhi and then to Kerala, amid violent…

news.title: Sohrabuddin case: Supreme Court says it will not reopen Amit Shah's discharge but seeks CBI reply on plea against acquittal of others

news.title: Centre to send teams to assess drought in Karnataka, Maharashtra: Shivraj Singh Chouhan
news.summary: “We will send a central team to Karnataka on October 3 to assess the drought situation. I have spoken with the Chief Minister of Maharashtra, who is concerned as well, and we will send a central team there too.

news.title: 4 Years After Her Death, Court Says Centre Can Make Cancer Drug She Needed
news.summary: The Kerala High Court held that the Centre has the power under the Patents Act to manufacture patented life-saving medicines and sell them at cheaper rates to patients who cannot afford them - a ruling that came after a petition filed by a…

news.title: In R Veeramani Case, Another Woman Says Minor Daughter Was Sexually Abused
news.summary: The complaint was filed as the Special Investigation Team (SIT) continued its investigation into the case involving Veeramani.

news.title: Another deep depression forms after Cyclone Arnab threat passes: Here's what IMD said

news.summary: The MMDR Amendment Act passed in Parliament on August 13 provides for restrictions on states’ powers to tax mineral rights

news.title: J&K Assembly Passes Statehood Resolution Amid BJP Walkout
news.summary: BJP MLAs stormed into the well of the house shouting slogans for sacking the government led by Omar Abdullah and removing assembly Speaker Abdul Rahim Rather

news.summary: CCTV footage showed six people arriving on three two-wheelers; police allege the wire was sold in small lots to scrap shops in Kuppam and Tamil Nadu

news.title: Indian Coast Guard saves foreign chemical tanker from capsizing off Paradip coast, 23 onboard rescued
news.summary: An ICG Dornier aircraft confirmed that the minor palm-oil sheen observed in the area had completely dissipated.

news.title: ‘Issue directions to Indradev’: UP man files complaint against God over incessant rain

news.summary: Ramesh Chennithala calls for collective action to keep drug mafia away. Second phase to focus on strengthening public participation through local bodies to prevent drug use and its spread

news.summary: Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis accused Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi and the Congress of attempting to erode public confidence in constitutional institutions; Opposition parties accepted ECI when they won elections but…

news.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay declares open renovated Gandhi Memorial Museum in Madurai

news.title: Ecostani| SIR Politics: A loss of trust for the Election Commission

news.summary: The CJP has announced a protest in Mumbai's Shivaji Park on October 2, seeking the resignation of Gyanesh Kumar.

news.title: J&K Assembly passes resolution demanding urgent restoration of full statehood
